python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('.local/apple-stt-benchmark/app.swift')
s=p.read_text().replace('import Speech','import Speech\nimport AppKit\nlet app = NSApplication.shared\napp.setActivationPolicy(.regular)')
s=s.replace('RunLoop.main.run()', 'app.run()')
p.write_text(s)
PY
kill -TERM 12689
swiftc .local/apple-stt-benchmark/app.swift -o '.local/apple-stt-benchmark/OpenCut Speech Test.app/Contents/MacOS/probe'
codesign --force --sign - '.local/apple-stt-benchmark/OpenCut Speech Test.app'
